proof_body:
by
  classical
  intro Ω _ _ X
  have h : ∑ ω, X ω = ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.image X, ∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => X ω = x), X ω :=
    (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun ω _ => Finset.mem_image_of_mem X (Finset.mem_univ ω)) X).symm
  rw [h, Finset.sum_div]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
  have : ∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => X ω = x), X ω = ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => X ω = x)).card : ℝ) * x := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2), Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [this]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (X : Ω → ℝ), (∑ ω, X ω) / Fintype.card Ω = ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.image X, x * (((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => X ω = x)).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω)
